contentHtml:
In our seminar, we practice using simple game-theoretic models to improve critical thinking skills in reasoning, explanation, design, and communication. Our strong emphasis is on institutional and organizational design, encompassing a wide range of business models. While conversational proficiency in Japanese and English is recommended, it is not a prerequisite to benefit from the seminar.

(Accepting Double Degree)
